notes: Card: ' ف' 17 of the top 32, 'ف' 7, ' F' 3. Probes: split ' ف' 0.67-0.92, ' F'attah 0.95, ' f' in fällt 0.64; whole tokens ' fan' and ' Fat' stay under 0.04, so the label is about the split-off letter. Near misses keep the Arabic sentence or the Arab name and swap the word.
